_meta.indication: SUTENT is indicated for the treatment of advanced renal cell carcinoma. Approval is based on partial response rates and duration of responses; there are no randomized trials demonstrating clinical benefit such as increased survival or improvement in disease-related symptoms.

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study 1 — A Pivotal Study of SU011248 in the Treatment of Patients with Cytokine-Refractory Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma
pivotal_trials.design: Single-arm, multi-center study in patients who failed prior cytokine-based therapy (defined by radiographic disease progression per RECIST or WHO criteria); patients received 50 mg SUTENT on Schedule 4/2 until withdrawal criteria or progressive disease.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with cytokine-refractory metastatic renal cell carcinoma, all with prior nephrectomy required and histological clear-cell component required in Study 1.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: The primary endpoint was objective response rate (ORR); duration of response (DR) was also evaluated.
pivotal_trials.result: ORR (partial response) 25.5% (95% CI 17.5, 34.9), assessed by blinded core radiology laboratory; median duration of response 27.1 weeks (95% CI 24.4, *).

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Study 2 — single-arm study of SU011248 in cytokine-refractory MRCC
pivotal_trials.design: Single-arm, multi-center study; failure of prior cytokine therapy defined as disease progression or unacceptable treatment-related toxicity; patients received 50 mg SUTENT on Schedule 4/2.
pivotal_trials.population: Patients with cytokine-refractory metastatic renal cell carcinoma; 95% of pooled population had at least some clear-cell histology component.
pivotal_trials.endpoint: The primary endpoint was objective response rate (ORR); duration of response (DR) was also evaluated.
pivotal_trials.result: ORR (partial response) 36.5% (95% CI 24.7, 49.6), assessed by investigators (23 PRs); median duration of response 54 weeks (95% CI 34.3, 70.1).

key_safety: In MRCC studies (N=169), the most common adverse events (all grades) were fatigue (74%), diarrhea (55%), nausea (54%), mucositis/stomatitis (53%), hypertension (28%), and bleeding at all sites (26%). Serious risks include left ventricular dysfunction (LVEF decrease below LLN in 15% of MRCC patients) and hemorrhagic events.
target_moa: Sunitinib malate is a small molecule that inhibits multiple receptor tyrosine kinases implicated in tumor growth, pathologic angiogenesis, and metastatic progression, including PDGFRα and PDGFRβ, VEGFR1/2/3, KIT, FLT3, CSF-1R, and RET.

surrogate_endpoint.text: Partial response rates and duration of responses (ORR/DR from single-arm studies) served as the basis for accelerated approval.

citations.quote: Approval for advanced renal cell carcinoma is based on partial response rates and duration of responses. There are no randomized trials of SUTENT demonstrating clinical benefit such as increased survival or improvement in disease-related symptoms in renal cell carcinoma.

confirmatory_requirement.text: Required confirmatory data from the Phase 3 randomized study of SU011248 versus interferon-α as first-line systemic therapy for metastatic RCC — interim then final analysis including PFS, OS, response rate and duration of response — to verify clinical benefit.

citations.quote: Products approved under the accelerated approval regulations, 21 CFR 314.510, require further adequate and well-controlled studies to verify and describe clinical benefit.

Submit efficacy data obtained at the final analysis, including progression-free survival, overall survival, response rate and duration of response; as well as updated safety data for study titled “A Phase 3, Randomized Study of SU011248 versus Interferon-\alpha as First-Line Systemic Therapy for Patients with Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma”. This submission will include the final study report as well as raw and derived data sets.

summary.text: NDA 21-968 for advanced renal cell carcinoma was approved under the accelerated approval regulations (21 CFR 314.510), based on partial response rates and duration of responses from single-arm studies, with required confirmatory studies to verify and describe clinical benefit.

citations.quote: NDA 21-968 for the treatment of advanced renal cell carcinoma is approved under the provisions of accelerated approval regulations (21 CFR 314.510), effective on the date of this letter, for use as recommended in the agreed-upon labeling text.

requirement.text: Submit follow-up LVEF data for patients 16, 46, and 81 on the pivotal cytokine-refractory MRCC study, with case narratives and additional cardiac evaluations, plus LVEF/narratives for any patient with documented LVEF ≤ 40% and/or cardiac failure after initial data cutoff.

citations.quote: Submit follow-up left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) data for patients 16, 46, and 81 on the study titled “A Pivotal Study of SU011248 in the Treatment of Patients with Cytokine-Refractory Metastatic Renal Cell Carcinoma”. Case narratives should be submitted and should include additional cardiac evaluations that were performed and treatments that were administered for congestive heart failure. Additionally, submit LVEF data and clinical narratives for any patient who, after the data cutoff for the initial NDA submission, had a documented LVEF of \le 40\% and/or signs and symptoms of cardiac failure.

requirement.text: Submit comparative LVEF and cardiac safety data for patients enrolled on the adjuvant RCC trial E2805 (adjuvant sunitinib vs sorafenib vs placebo in resected RCC), with a revised protocol for ejection fraction monitoring.

The protocol will be revised to include a plan acceptable to the FDA for ejection fraction monitoring at baseline and follow-up.
